name: Temporary governed WP-MVP-0005 start

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - execution/start-wp-mvp-0005

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  start:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: execution/start-wp-mvp-0005
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Reconcile branch before governed transition
        run: |
          sleep 12
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git pull --rebase origin execution/start-wp-mvp-0005

      - name: Remove one-shot workflow from final tree
        run: rm .github/workflows/tmp-start-wp-mvp-0005.yml

      - name: Start authorized Work Packet through canonical EOS
        env:
          EOS_ACTOR: github-actions[bot]
        run: ./scripts/eos start WP-MVP-0005

      - name: Refresh deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py

      - name: Validate started state and projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          ./scripts/eos state status

      - name: Commit governed start transition
        run: |
          git add -A
          git commit -m "chore(eos): start WP-MVP-0005"
          git pull --rebase origin execution/start-wp-mvp-0005
          git push origin HEAD:execution/start-wp-mvp-0005
